title: Event-Time GPU Credit Ledger
prompt:
Implement an `EventTimeCreditLedger` with these methods:

```python
add_credit(label, amount, start, duration)
debit(amount, timestamp)
get_balance(timestamp) -> int | None
```

Every `add_credit` call creates a distinct grant, even if `label` repeats. A grant is usable at every integer time in the closed interval `[start, start + duration]`. Calls can arrive in any order, so `get_balance(t)` must replay only the writes received so far in `(event timestamp, receipt order)` order rather than call order.

A debit consumes currently usable grants with the earliest expiration first. An underfunded debit is allowed: retain its unmet amount as debt. A later grant first pays outstanding debt, then any remainder becomes an active grant. Before applying an event at time `t`, discard grants whose expiration is strictly before `t`; a grant expiring at `t` is still usable.

For a query, return `None` if no grant window created so far contains `timestamp`, or if replay leaves a negative balance. Otherwise return active grant credit minus outstanding debt. A query must not mutate the write log or query results at other timestamps. Inputs use non-negative integer amounts and durations.

example.reasoning: The late-arriving grant is replayed at event time 15 before the debit at time 24.
